title: Render meal-plan item rows and persist swipe deletions
description: Add row rendering for recipe, text, and ingredient items, hook recipe taps into `RecipeDetailSheet`, and persist swipe deletions through typed plan mutation and reserialisation.
acceptance_criteria: Recipe rows resolve recipe URLs, show thumbnails or placeholders, display optional servings text, and open the existing recipe detail sheet.
Text rows render plain text with semibold styling only for trailing-colon labels and remain non-interactive.
Ingredient rows render the cart icon and quantity text formatting required by the spec.
Swipe-to-delete on supported row types mutates the in-memory `MealPlan`, serialises it once, and writes back via `MealPlanFiles.writeText` without string surgery in the view layer.
